name: quantum-operations
description: Hardware-agnostic, implementation-grade FTQC skills with affirmative guidance, exact algorithms, worked examples, current tool/API references, verification, scheduling, and resource estimation.

interface.longDescription: Skills for designing, optimizing, verifying, scheduling, and estimating fault-tolerant quantum computations, including reversible arithmetic, Boolean fusion, Clifford+T optimization, QEC, lattice surgery, real-time decoding, runtime control, resource estimation, and hardware-aware validation.
defaultPrompt: Use Quantum Operations to audit this quantum implementation for logical-width, non-Clifford, QEC, runtime, and resource bottlenecks.
Use Quantum Operations to design an exact fault-tolerant implementation of this algorithm and verify each lowering stage.
Use Quantum Operations to compare circuit optimizations and report logical width, non-Clifford cost, depth, scheduling constraints, and physical-resource assumptions.
